notes.notes: Removed flash effect when starting battles.

-Fixed a bug that crashed the game if a hero died while on its turn and had a revive skill active.
-Fixed The Four Seasons skill not working properly if multiple heroes had the skill.
Fixed a bug which caused enemy Storm (used by Murky Swamp boss) to continue proccing if it killed a hero, making it very likely to wipe your party.

Added support to Steam Cloud Saving.

You can access it by going to Options => Cloud Saving. There you will be able to either upload your current save file to Steam cloud or Download the file from the cloud, overwriting your local file. This is useful if you want to play on different devices, e.g. Steam Deck and PC.

[list]
[*] Added WASD movement support.
[*] Fixed a bug with the following skills: Frigid Wake and Vampiric Aura. Previously, they would be constantly turned off if you had more than one hero with them in your party and one of them had the passive toggled off. Now if you have multiple heroes with the skill, it will apply the effects from the hero with the highest skill rank.
[*] Dragon Breath: Decreased the cooldown to 2 turns, the different effects now fully stack.
[*] Fixed skill rank up on level up going to hidden skills.
[/list]
Fixed crashing when using self damaging skills while having some buffs such as Paladin's Protect.
Fixed translation issues and mistakes for the following languages: Thai, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

-Added the ability to change the heroes' names.
-Added the ability to hide hero skills from the menus (to avoid cluttering late game if you have too many skills).
-Freezing should be fixed: This was an engine bug that, for some reason, never happened during testing. Again, if anyone still have freezing issues, let me know.
Attempt to fix freezing issue. For those that were having freezing issues, let me know if this patch solves them.
